title: keel: where we are
subtitle: Milestones for keel itself, tracked with keel.

milestones.name: First release
milestones.exit: A project can install keel in Claude Code or Codex, get the rules and skills, and track progress through MCP, CLI and the dashboard on Node.js, PHP or Python.

steps.title: Progress model: validate, summarize, set status, add step, format
AI-mention scanning for text, patches and commit commands
Project config, registry and safe file store
Rule modules: core, clean code, no AI footprint, delegation
Workflow skills: plan, implement, delegate, review, ADR, commit
Quality skills: clean code, UI/UX, progress, setup
Reviewer agents: security, tests, UX, performance
Session start: rules and progress line
Edit guard: protected files and AI mentions
Commit, tag and PR text check
Standalone commit-msg git hook
MCP server over stdio
CLI: init, progress, check-ai, git-hooks, projects, serve, mcp
HTTP contract and shared test suite
Node.js, PHP and Python servers
Dashboard with project switcher, paging and themes
Launcher menus for Bash and PowerShell
Plugin manifests and marketplaces for both tools
Pinned upstream plugins: ui-ux-pro-max, engineering
README and API docs
Install into a real project and use it for a week
Verify plugin install end to end in Claude Code
Verify plugin install end to end in Codex

questions.q: Should keel also be published to npm, or is installing from GitHub enough?

steps.title: Statuses: waiting for your check, blocked with reason
Questions and answers per task
Linked documents with a reader
Collapsible tasks, status bar, search and filters
Fix the eleven findings with regression tests

milestones.name: Smoother everyday use
milestones.when: after a week of real use
milestones.exit: No manual steps after installing the plugin, in either tool.
